description: Which byte ranges a DAO shared read-only session holds locked, on the lock file and on the database file (R-LOCK-2 RO-NATIVE: the record is written at offset 0; how a slot is marked in use is not known). Open r-cursor-1-nav shared read-only; open the .laccdb and the .accdb natively (GENERIC_READ, share read/write/delete) and bisect [0, 2^62) of each with exclusive fail-immediately LockFileEx requests, recording every byte another handle holds; read the lock file's first 256 bytes and keep both files. Repeat with a table-type recordset on T open after MoveLast. Close and observe the files. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
retentionNote: W-10/native-readers-only RO-NATIVE: lock-file slot byte 0x10000001 and record; recordset adds 0x40005401/0x50005401; no locks on the database
